paragraphs: Rabbi Shmuel bar Sumtar. See the entry Rabbi Shmuel bar Susarta.

notes.text: The catalog heading reads Sotar (סוטר); the frozen body reads Sumtar (סומטר), with a target Susarta (סוסרטא). The heading-to-body discrepancy remains open.

The saved named Guggenheimer Berakhot 1:1 paragraph has Shmuel bar Sotar (סוטר); its Yevamot 16:9:2 paragraph names Shmuel bar Susarta (סוסרטא). The frozen body instead has Sumtar (סומטר), while the catalog heading has Sotar. The distinct forms are retained without an identity equation or a claim to have verified Hyman’s glyphs.

The consulted scan of Hyman, volume III, printed p. 1146, reads ר׳ שמואל בר סומטר. ערך ר׳ שמואל בר סוסרטא, confirming the frozen Sumtar-to-Susarta pointer. The displayed title preserves the catalog’s Sotar (סוטר), also found in the consulted Yerushalmi Berakhot 1:1; the consulted Yevamot 16:9:2 names Shmuel bar Susarta. Hyman’s pointer is reported as his cross-reference, without equating these name forms in an authority record. The earlier notes describe the state before this inspection of Hyman’s printed glyphs.
